operator_error.description: A cleanup SSH command was constructed with local double-quoted shell interpolation. The local shell expanded $pat to the empty string before transmission, so the remote pgrep expression was broader than intended and terminated job-container processes on both nodes.
operator_error.impact: Both job SSH endpoints now refuse connections; subsequent GPU work cannot continue until both allocations are restarted or replaced.

recovery_required: restart or recreate both BAAI jobs
update SSH aliases if allocation IDs change
do not rerun the known local-rank-only cudaProfilerStop mechanism
resume baseline and pipeline capacity searches from fresh run IDs
